columns.name: CASE NUMBER
columns.description: System--assigned number

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Full site address.

columns.name: STREET NUMBER FROM
columns.description: This is the numeric portion of the address. For ranged addresses, this value is the lower number in the range.

columns.name: STREET NUMBER TO
columns.description: This is the numeric portion of the address. For ranged addresses, this value is the higher number in the range. This value is blank for single (non-range) addresses.

columns.name: DIRECTION
columns.description: The direction (N,S,E,W) portion of the address.

columns.name: STREET NAME
columns.description: The name of the street

columns.name: STREET TYPE
columns.description: The street name suffix (e.g. ST = Street, AVE = Avenue. BLVD = Boulevard, etc).

columns.name: DOCKET NO.
columns.description: The unique identifier assigned to the case. A docket number can contain multiple tickets.

columns.name: TICKET NO.
columns.description: The unique identifier of the issued ticket. A ticket can contain up to two code violations. NOTE that the Department of Environment Ticket No.’s may refer to non-unique violations.

columns.name: RESPONDENT
columns.description: The name of the entity issued the code violation notice.

columns.name: CASE TYPE
columns.description: The Case Types are historic 3-Day Notice, Air Pollution Defect Notice, Administrative Hearing, Summary Abatement, Chicago Storage Tank NOV, State Administrative Citation, State Violation Notice, historic Pre Enforcement Conference, and historic Ticket-Municipal Prosecution.

columns.name: VIOLATION DATE
columns.description: The date of the code violation.

columns.name: CODE VIOLATION
columns.description: The municipal or state code being cited in the ticket.

columns.name: DISPOSITION
columns.description: The outcome of the individual code violation.

columns.name: CASE STATUS
columns.description: The final or most current status of the case.

columns.name: FINE AMOUNT
columns.description: This is the total fine assessed for the case not including court fees. Note that for the Historic Department of Environment data, this value is not unique to the record but applies to the entire case. For example, the case with a Docket No of 07DE000171 has two records with a fine amount of $350 in each record. The total fine on the case is $350, not the sum of $700.

columns.name: COMMENT
columns.description: Additional information relating to the violation or case.

columns.name: DATA SOURCE
columns.description: The city department that collected the data.

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: Latitude coordinate of the facility (low end if an address range).

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: Longitude coordinate of the facility (low end if an address range).

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the facility in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.
